scores.evidence: Both objectives are can-do statements (「設計できる」 create, 「判断できる」 evaluate). o1 is assessed by q1, q2 (apply), e1 and e2, and o2 by q3, q4 and e3 (evaluate). e3, the teammate's self-check, assesses o2's checklist-based judgement most directly.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「初日にスキル（skill）5つとフック（hook）3つを一度に入れようとして、手が止まりました」) and says what the learner will do. The ungraded pq0 that follows leads straight to o1, and its explanation already names the day-1 exception for secrets and push.

The prerequisites list course titles that match content/courses/claude-code/course.json exactly (for example 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」). dr-table recalls each part together with the lesson that taught it (「（第6回）」, 「（subagent、第7回）」). The only new term, きっかけ, is defined in dr-b1 before the table uses it, and katakana terms carry their English on first use (プラグイン（plugin）, コンテキスト（context）).

measure.mjs gives 「prose 1344 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 1894 · practice reading 1672 · questions 8 · practice sections 3 · est 19.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」, and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. The example section is the densest part: 6 blocks, and ex-prompt-skill's expect and note pack four mechanics (allowed-tools, the `!` injection, /reload-skills, the failure in a repo with no commits) next to the jq/xargs hook in ex-hook. The lesson is within budget but sits near the 20-minute cap.

ex-steps comes before practice: 5 steps with subgoal titles, the reason for each (「Claudeがテストのコマンドを2回まちがえたのが、きっかけです。」, 「整形の忘れが続いたので」) and an expect, backed by the full files in ex-prompt-claude-md, ex-settings and ex-prompt-skill. There is no faded step between the full example and the independent practice in practice-setup.

4 of the 5 content sections end in an inline check (q1–q4); only practice-setup has none, so 2 sections never go by without one. q1 and q2 ask the learner to apply the trigger table to new symptoms (ESLint forgotten, `npm install` repeated), and q3 and q4 are evaluate items. Every option has feedback.

The brief's 7 misconceptions all appear as distractors, each with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer that gives a reason. Examples: q1 b 「強調しても、CLAUDE.mdはお願いのままです。」, q2 b 「拒否すると、package.jsonを変えたときにも入れられなくなります。」, q3 d 「あらを探すよう頼まれたレビュアーは、問題のない作業にも指摘を出します。」, e3 c 「自分の作業を採点すると、甘くなりがちです。」.

cycle-flow shows a process: 5 nodes and a review loop. Its labels match the cycle-steps titles word for word (「探索して計画する」 … 「コミットする」), and the caption states the takeaway (「レビューで直す指摘があれば、実装と検証に戻る」). dr-table is a real 2-column comparison of trigger and part. There are no decorative images.

The task is authentic: the learner's own repository (on a working branch) and a postponed small change taken through a full cycle. Every step has an expect, self-check-list serves as the success criteria, and model answers are given (setup-prompt-model, setup-settings-model, and the expected plan in cycle-prompt-plan). The hint ladder is uneven: c-review, c-explain and c-commit have no hint or troubleshoot, and p-claude-md's 「25行以内」 is given without a reason.

The summary follows the exam: 4 points, a reflection prompt (「この1サイクルで、自分で判断した場面を1行で書いておきましょう。」), a next step that matches the course's end (「これで全11回は終わりです。次は、演習3で決めた部品を足していきましょう。」), 7 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

All 3 issues that audit-cc-11-capstone.json confirmed are fixed in the current text: ex-prompt-skill 「起動後に `.claude/skills/` を新しく作ったときは、先に `/reload-skills` を実行します」, setup-prompt-model 「Pythonのスクリプトが開くファイルは防げません」, and card-ask without 必ず plus 「`git -C . push` のような別の書き方には一致しません」. The auto-mode start (「v2.1.283以降、ターミナルとVS Codeの対話セッション」) and dr-b2's limits on permission rules match cross-lesson-facts.md items 1, 3, 4 and 6. Version and date are pinned in the subtitle, and the hook command matches the docs recipe in facts-cc-11-capstone.md.

The text keeps です・ます, stays calm and has no banned phrases (lint clean), for example 「次は、演習3で決めた部品を足していきましょう。」. It slips once on its central term: sc-b1 calls an unmet checklist item a きっかけ (「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すもののきっかけです。」), while the glossary defines きっかけ as 「同じ困りごとが繰り返し起きること」.

The jp locale is complete. cycle-flow's alt names all 5 stages and the loop back. The only link has descriptive text (「公式ドキュメントの日本語版」). Plain-text checklist labels use 「/clear」 instead of markdown code, and no text is baked into images.

niceToHave: sc-b1 widens the glossary term きっかけ (「同じ困りごとが繰り返し起きること」) to mean an unmet checklist item. Change 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すもののきっかけです。」 to 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すものの候補です。」

p-claude-md (setup-steps) expects 「25行以内」 with no reason, while e3 a's feedback says 40 lines is within the official guide (「200行未満」). Change p-claude-md's hint to 「最初は25行以内を目安にします。各行に「消したらまちがえる？」と聞きます。」
c-review (cycle-steps) has no hint or troubleshoot. Add the hint 「指摘が多すぎたら、計画の要件に関わるものだけに絞ってと頼みます。」
c-commit (cycle-steps) has no hint. Add the hint 「1行目が長すぎたら、「変えた内容を1行目に短く」と頼みます。」

worked (to reach 4): add a faded step before practice-setup. For example, add an inline item in which the learner picks the part for ③ (「整形の忘れが続いた」) before ex-steps reveals it, or leave one ex-steps item's md for the learner to complete.
cycle-prompt-plan is titled 「模範解答：計画の依頼文」, but c-plan tells the learner to send it (「下の依頼文を送ります」), so it is a template, not a model answer to check against. Change the title to 「計画の依頼文と、返ってくる計画の例」.
ex-hook (ex-steps ③) relies on `jq`, but the lesson never says it must be installed. Add the troubleshoot 「整形されないときは、`jq --version` で `jq` が入っているかを確かめます。」

ex-b1 says ① was set up on day 1, while ex-claude-md names a trigger that takes time to happen (「2回まちがえた」). To make the timeline clear, change ex-claude-md's md to 「初日に、Claudeがテストのコマンドを2回まちがえました。これがきっかけです。推測できないことだけを書きます。」
dr-table row 1 has no verb (「CLAUDE.mdに1行（第6回）」), while the brief's outline reads 「CLAUDE.mdに1行足す（第6回）」. Use the outline's wording so the row names an action.

Factual doubt: ex-prompt-skill's 「確認なしで使えます」 could be read as allowed-tools overriding the deny and ask rules that ex-rules just set. facts-cc-11-capstone.md (safety-7) says an allow 「cannot carve an exception out of a deny」. If cc-skills confirms that deny rules still win, add after that sentence: 「拒否ルールは、それでも優先されます。」
load: ex-prompt-skill's expect is the densest block. To lighten the example section, consider moving the /reload-skills paragraph into the note, next to the no-commit warning.
summary: Full review, because the lesson moved from the vibe-coding drafts to content/courses/claude-code/lessons/ and courseId changed, and the review gate no longer accepts the earlier chain under the old path. Its main strength is close alignment: one rule (start with CLAUDE.md, add a part when its trigger comes, and put secrets and push behind permission rules from day 1) runs through the hook, worked example, three authentic practice tasks, transfer exam items and accurate, cited facts. validate shows 0 errors, lint --strict shows 0 warnings, and measure.mjs gives est 19.3 min for estMinutes 19. There is no must-fix. The most useful improvements are a faded step before practice, a fuller hint ladder in cycle-steps, and using きっかけ only in its glossary sense in sc-b1.
